provenance.scope: Every scan of parts 1 and 3 of the printed facsimile, part 1 first, in library order inside each part. Plates, printed matter, blanks and boards are separated by the measured rule below. No manuscript folio number is inferred from the scan order. Part 2 was never published in this digitised run, so folios 117 to 220 are absent, and part 4 is a 1930 index from which nothing hangs.
provenance.page_kind_basis: Measured on the page's inner field, away from the gutter shadow: an inset photograph of a leaf is a locally uniform mid tone, printed type is not. The boards and the borderline pages were read as images.
